evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit treatment-record interfaces can transfer existing fields and bounded narrative assistance can organize captured clinical facts; full clinical verification remains essential.

assumptions: Actual treatment equipment produces delivered-dose/settings records; the therapist produces reaction observations and captures missing narrative in s1. Clinical owners supply approved field mappings. No ambient recording, inferred reaction or new data feed is assumed.

Transfer requires actual patient, session, source version, field/unit mapping and delivery status. Missing/conflicting values stop for manual handling in s4. Draft transfer cannot alter the treatment device or prescription.

Native interfaces/templates first. Existing equivalent transfer removes the gain; already-computed dose and device runtime earn no saving. All retained semantic statements are checked against actual captured facts.

This is maintaining actual required records/reports/files, not inventing duplicate reports. Deduplicate the same education note from 4095 and any dose entry from 4096 when they are the same action.
The final record exists before s4's complete verification; edits invalidate the gate. No hidden external report send or treatment-plan approval is proposed.

assumptions: The actual clinical team supplies prescription, instructions and existing patient images/records. The therapist verifies sources in s1 and produces physical and technical contributions in s2/s3. No new segmentation, patient model or approved plan is assumed.

Native views first. Missing sources, changed patient conditions or out-of-scope questions require actual clinical review; no model supplies plan parameters or substitutes for physician/physicist approval.

assumptions: This is an actual duplicate-input calculation workflow, not a claim that modern treatment systems lack dose computation. Required inputs include actual patient/session/source version, delivered values, units and delivery status. Missing/conflicting values or unsupported methods stop for manual clinical handling in s3. No model arithmetic, dose recommendation or inferred measurement is used.

Native approved interfaces first; existing equivalent input transfer removes the gain. Existing dose calculation runtime earns no saving and remains within the fully retained s3 verification/calculation work.

Actual final result and destination are checked in s3 before s4; edits invalidate the gate. No hidden treatment plan approval, beam activation or external report send is proposed.
